reason: The text is from Nehemiah 1-2 and describes Yahweh's active goodness and favor toward the people of Israel. Nehemiah repeatedly emphasizes God's protective hand and blessing upon the restoration work ('the hand of my God which was good upon me'). The narrative depicts God enabling the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls and the restoration of the people—the opposite of rejecting them or considering replacement. There is no statement in this passage about Yahweh not owing loyalty or contemplating replacing Israel with another people.
